# Bikram Pandit

> PhD candidate in Artificial Intelligence at Oregon State University (Dynamic Robotics and AI Lab, advised by Alan Fern). Research focuses on reinforcement learning for legged, wheeled, and hybrid single- and multi-robot systems, with a track record of transferring policies from simulation to hardware across platforms including Cassie, Digit, Spot, Unitree Go2, Unitree H1, and D1.

Previously interned at the RAI Institute (formerly Boston Dynamics AI Institute) and at MiCROTEC. Before the PhD, worked several years as a Senior Software Engineer at Digital Product Labs.
